She has never been obsessed with Disney stuff (our daughters loved Disney when they were little, but they’re out of the house now.) I suppose my wife always enjoyed Disney stuff but I assumed it was mostly for their sake. She makes me watch Frozen every day and when I asked for a change she put on Pocahontas 2. I know this is nothing compared to her pain of being cheated on, but I’m miserable and can’t do it. I want to have an intervention where we stop all the Disney stuff and just go to counseling which should have happened a while ago. AITA for wanting to back out?
